name: agent-hq
description: Agent team command center: plan-progress style bars above the prompt, and a sidebar with the agent tree, each agent's now/next/last task, todo tracks and animated mascots.

nicknameTheme.title: Nickname theme
nicknameTheme.description: The cast your agents' nicknames are drawn from: futuristic planets with a star for the lead by default. A new theme applies to agents named from now on.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Play a short sound when an agent finishes, needs you, fails, or the team levels up (terminals with audio only).
